title: Touring the South by bus; did Celestin run two bands?
summary: The band travelled by several buses all through the South but not east or north. She says she knows nothing of the rumor of two Celestin bands.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you all do much traveling in those days?
We did quite a bit of traveling.
I know in late days they had that big bus that I know used to be over there in front of Mr. Barberin's home sometimes.
Yes, we had several buses and we used to do quite a lot of traveling all through the south. We didn't get east or north, but we went all through the south.

You know, at one time people have told me, I don't know if it's true, I better check, that they had… Celestan had two bands. One sort of his band would stay here and play and another one out on the road at times. Do you remember anything like that?
Well, if he did, it wasn't when I was with him. Not when you were with him? No.
Because… So I don't know if it's really true or somebody just told me that and then maybe they were confused about it. I don't know anything about it.
